blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong met on the sidelines of the Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix on Sunday as the Philippine leader wrapped up his five-day working visit to the city-state. Wong shared a photograph on Facebook showing him seated beside Marcos at a dining table during the event. “Beyond the excitement on the track, the Singapore Grand Prix is also a wonderful opportunity to catch up with friends and partners from around the world,” Wong said in his post on Monday.
